instruction: Turn on the sharpen video effect and set its sigma to 1.0.

criteria.script: async () => { const data = await window.surfgym.get_configs({ criteria: [ { file: '.config/vlc/vlcrc', format: 'key_value', key: 'video-filter', default: '' } ] }); return data[0]; }
async () => { const data = await window.surfgym.get_configs({ criteria: [ { file: '.config/vlc/vlcrc', format: 'key_value', key: 'sharpen-sigma', default: '0.050000' } ] }); return data[0]; }
